messages:
Ana: Drafting a compact playbook + request template for SIEM exports + JIT KMS unwraps. Want quick eyes before I open a PR. Main goals: limit blast radius, ensure unwraps are auditable, add automatic IR triggers for noisy exports.

Ana: Proposed request template (single-line for ticket fields): `requestor: <name> | purpose: <investigation|forensics|third-party> | window: <start>-<end> | scope: <indices/services> | extract_retention_hrs: <int, default 24, max 72> | kms_unwrap_ttl_s: <int, default 3600, max 3600> | justification_url: <case/ticket> | approver: <sec-lead/oncall>`

Mike: Two policy points: 1) RBAC roles split: `export_requester` vs `export_approver`. 2) Require `X-Justification` header — must be logged with every export event.

Jeff: SRE ask: add auto-snapshot of the raw stream to a locked bucket for 7d on any JIT unwrap. Makes triage much easier. Note: include region tag to avoid surprise egress charges.

Lina: Compliance: differentiate retention by log category. Auth/access logs = 180d audit store; infra/ops logs = 90d. Also require a human approver for extract_retention_hrs > 24.

Samir: IR rules: if export contains >50 unique user IDs OR >100 admin-level events, auto-page sec-oncall within 15m. Also write SHA256 of exported file into the audit entry.

Nora: Small addition: record checksum + size + object path in the immutable audit record and store a pointer to the locked snapshot. That helps replay and verification.

Mike: KMS unwrap runbook snippet we should include in the PR: `kmsctl unwrap --token $JIT_TOKEN --key export-key --ttl 3600 --out /dev/null` and ensure only the audit service receives stdout/stderr. Don’t let agents stash local copies.

Ana: Implementation proposal: 1) Export API enforces `max_extract_retention=72` and default 24. 2) Approvals service issues one-time JIT tokens scoped to `object_id` and `ttl_s`. 3) Any unwrap writes audit: user, approver, justification header, checksum, object path, region, and snapshot pointer.

Jeff: I'll prototype the snapshot hook + cost estimate and open a feature-flagged PR (flag: `feature/export-timebox-jit`) to infra.

DeployBot: ci/cd check 1: feature flag `feature/export-timebox-jit` missing infra-config entry. Pipeline: https://ci.redwood.example/pipe/9092

Ana: One more UX note: default extract retention should be 24h and approver can extend to 72h with explicit justification link. I'll add the RBAC matrix (who can request, who can approve, who can view snapshots) and thresholds to the PR.

Samir: For the escalation numbers we can start conservatively (50 users / 100 admin events) and tune after a month of telemetry. Make escalation rules configurable per-org.

Lina: Also add a requirement that exports meant for third parties include a data-minimization checklist and legal signoff field in the ticket.

Ana: Thanks all. Ill draft the policy PR with the template, RBAC matrix, runbook snippets, and Samir's auto-alert rules. Ping me if you want changes before RFC. :thumbsup:
